current_reporting_state: Root reports nine assessment areas after expansion; original five steps and two legacy RA slots were held. This packager does not edit shared reporting data.

recommended_assessment_area_bindings.scope_limit: Normal MRI zones and polyp/mass examples. Native source age/cycle not supplied for the normal figure; no independently calibrated source pixel spacing.
Same-wall depth ratio, superficial/deep/no-invasion examples and early-enhancement rim. Do not infer microscopic invasion or replace acquisition review with a static published view.
Endocervical-canal and stromal extent source cases; histopathologic certainty is not independently verified.
Serosal contour and ovarian/tubal/broad-ligament examples. IA3 source organ extent alone does not establish every required pathologic criterion or distinguish synchronous ovarian primary.

Upper-vaginal, pelvic-sidewall, bladder/rectosigmoid/ureter and direct-rectal examples. Figure19 supplies local bladder-base/urethral MRI and separate fused PET observations, not distant coverage or verified postoperative anatomy. Source mucosal claims are retained author interpretations; no mucosal clinical certification or every named fascial/ligament detail.
Pelvic/obturator and para-aortic source observations; CT Figure4 has two patients. Micrometastasis, isolated tumour cells and nodal histologic burden cannot be established from these bitmaps.

Pelvic/abdominal peritoneal MRI and CT; distant lungs are CT-only ancillary observations. Pelvic local views are not whole-body coverage. Figure19 is assigned to adjacent organs because its source-supported findings are bladder-base/urethral involvement.

Complete MRI mimic figure for leiomyoma, adenomyosis and cornual location; expansion/no-invasion pitfall. Dedicated plane-planning images, uterine version/flexion variants, congenital anomalies and age/cycle normal comparisons remain source gaps in this endometrial package.

Baseline post-primary-treatment vaginal recurrence MRI; three separate paired-sequence recurrence cases and post-chemoradiotherapy PET-CT nodal recurrence. No actual serial pre/post-treatment MRI response pair is supplied. Do not bind these as a normal response or as the current case.

source_conflicts.issue: The source change list misdescribes IIB as myometrial invasion at any histologic aggressiveness. Primary FIGO2023 IIB is nonaggressive histology with substantial LVSI; IIC is aggressive histology with myometrial invasion. Do not use the secondary change-list wording as criteria or infer LVSI/histology from MRI.

source_conflicts.issue: The source prose says no LVSI for IA3. The primary FIGO2023 IA3 criterion excludes substantial/extensive LVSI, not every focal LVSI. A figure case described as no LVSI is publication-supplied case information and is not a universal criterion or an MRI inference.
